assessment_details.rationale: Concrete distributed-training correctness evidence is useful but indirect to O's current recursive-context and continuity/recovery bottlenecks.
Predictable unbiased evidence reuse directly informs O's goal of reducing experiment cost without weakening evidence validity.
Safe pilot/production reuse can reduce duplicated measurement and external latency if an O-appropriate estimator can be constructed.
The negative stress result is decision-useful for rejecting myopic allocation heuristics, but its particle-filter transfer to O is adaptation-heavy.
Ambiguous-launch generation invalidation maps directly to O's frozen requests, recovery fencing and independent evaluation integrity.
No-retry after a possibly launched observation directly protects O from selective duplicate sampling across crash recovery.
Stable process-epoch identity directly strengthens O's fresh-process and sharded-evaluation provenance.
Freshness-budget allocation is directly relevant to O's source-clock/supersession design and to avoiding stale constraints under bounded context verification.
Treatment-blind endpoint validity is directly relevant to O's mechanically judged evaluation and claim boundaries.
Separating capability, exposure, susceptibility and realized unauthorized effects is directly relevant to protected self-improvement acceptance.
Interface compatibility is an immediate evaluator/executor validity check because O relies on bound tool and Work execution surfaces.
Payload-blind destination/capability constraints are highly relevant to O's tool/effect safety when context can contain adversarial instructions.
The provenance-weighting tradeoff is directly relevant to O's recursive context selection: integrity defenses must not erase the only correct untrusted evidence.
Evidence-view and evaluation-awareness effects directly inform O's held-out contamination and judge-validity controls.
AID-Guard closely matches O's external-effect recovery concerns and sharpens when retry/replacement is contractually inadmissible.
Verification-versus-retry interaction and hidden retry loci directly inform O's current recovery and continuation machinery.
The quiescence policy quantifies the safety/coverage cost of blocking under unresolved writers, directly relevant to O's single-writer recovery decisions.
Certified forward reconciliation is directly relevant when O can prove a safe terminal path without rollback.
Wait-settle-replan mirrors O's accepted-pending rechecks and gives a measured alternative when irreversible exposure matters.
A certified repair-policy archive fits O's evidence-driven strategy selection while preserving non-substitutable safety certificates.
Treating compensation as a separately identified effect graph is directly relevant to any O recovery path that must reverse realized external effects.
The CAUSE formula audit is a useful uncertainty-control analogue but remains distant from O's current software-control path.
Active source identification plus Bayesian model averaging is conceptually useful for context/source uncertainty, but current evidence is synthetic and adaptation-heavy.
PF-HMM is a future source-attribution candidate; no AI/O transfer is yet demonstrated.
Shared event-log authority is useful durability engineering, but O's principal state substrate is Git/CAS rather than this local JSONL stack.
Torn-tail isolation directly supports truthful journal/evidence replay after interrupted writes.
Persistability/projection invariants are useful event-sourcing hygiene but the Mission View specifics are Argus-local.
Preregistered adaptive-compute confirmation directly supports O's expected-time controller and protected-baseline optional-work evaluation.
Family heterogeneity in late unlocks is useful for O's heterogeneous routing but mainly as a caution against fixed shallow probes.
Component-level causal attribution is highly relevant: composite success must not be mistaken for evidence that an internal subcomponent adds value.
The direct-gap confirmation is a concrete example of a cheaper protected rule dominating a more complex probe under matched evidence.
Zero incremental gain for extra probing directly supports O's saturation and marginal-value stop/change rules.
The scope-limited probe conclusion gives O a direct experiment-design rule for optional computation on incumbent-reject states.
Reproduce-before-ablate attribution is directly relevant to O Candidate evaluation and to avoiding causal credit from unreproduced system-level gains.
Editable persistent repair memory supports O's reversible Candidate philosophy, but the evidence is cross-domain and not a matched O-like ablation.
The SIGKILL-tested OUTER evaluation state machine is directly relevant to O's idempotent Work/evaluation recovery and terminal certificate ordering.
